name: 安洁莉娜
description: 曾是一名普通的叙拉古少女，在感染矿石病后加入了罗德岛。作为辅助干员，她能为队伍提供强大的增益效果，同时具备不俗的输出能力。
descriptionEn: A former Siracusan girl who joined Rhodes Island after being infected with Oripathy. As a Supporter operator, she provides powerful buffs to the team while maintaining decent damage output.
descriptionJa: かつてシラクーザの普通の少女だったが、鉱石病に感染後、ローズアイランドに加入。サポートオペレーターとして強力なバフを味方に付与しつつ、そこそこの火力も出せる。

faq.question: Is Angelina good in Endfield?
faq.answer: Angelina is a top-tier supporter in Endfield, providing excellent ATK speed buffs and arts damage support for the team.
faq.answerZh: 安洁莉娜是Endfield中的顶级辅助，能为队伍提供优秀的攻速加成和源石技艺伤害支援。

faq.question: What is Angelina's best team comp?
faq.questionZh: 安洁莉娜的最佳配队是什么？
faq.answer: Angelina pairs best with Surtr for arts damage and Amiya as sub-DPS, with Saria as healer/tank.
faq.answerZh: 安洁莉娜与史尔特尔搭配源石技艺输出，阿米娅作为副C，塞雷娅担任治疗/坦克。

tierReason: Top-tier supporter with strong buffs and arts damage. Essential for arts teams.
tierReasonZh: 顶级辅助，拥有强力增益和源石技艺输出，源石队伍核心。

normalAttack.name: 速射模式
normalAttack.description: 对目标进行快速的源石技艺攻击，造成源石技艺伤害。
normalAttack.descriptionEn: Performs rapid Originium Arts attacks on the target, dealing Arts damage.
normalAttack.descriptionJa: 目標に速いオリジニウムアーツ攻撃を行い、アーツダメージを与える。

skill.name: 秘影·加速力场
skill.nameJa: 秘影・加速フィールド
skill.description: 展开加速力场，提升范围内友方单位的攻击速度，并持续对敌人造成源石技艺伤害。
skill.descriptionEn: Deploys an acceleration field that boosts ATK speed of allies within range and continuously deals Arts damage to enemies.

ultimate.name: 反重力模式
ultimate.description: 开启反重力装置，大幅提升全体友方的攻击力和攻击速度，并对全场敌人造成持续源石技艺伤害。
ultimate.descriptionEn: Activates anti-gravity device, greatly boosting all allies' ATK and ATK speed while dealing continuous Arts damage to all enemies.

passive.name: 源石适应
passive.description: 在场时，所有源石技艺类型干员的攻击力提升10%。
passive.descriptionEn: While on the field, increases ATK of all Arts-type operators by 10%.
passive.descriptionJa: フィールドにいる間、全アーツタイプオペレーターの攻撃力を10%上昇。

teamComps.name: 源石技艺爆发队
teamComps.description: 以史尔特尔为核心输出，安洁莉娜提供攻速增益，阿米娅副C，塞雷娅治疗兼坦克。
teamComps.descriptionEn: Centered on Surtr as main DPS, Angelina provides ATK speed buffs, Amiya as sub-DPS, and Saria as healer/tank.

name: 史尔特尔
description: 来自萨米的神秘少女，拥有操控火焰的强大源石技艺。作为近卫干员，她拥有毁灭性的近战源石技艺输出能力。
descriptionEn: A mysterious girl from Sami with powerful fire-manipulating Originium Arts. As a Guard operator, she possesses devastating melee Arts damage output.
descriptionJa: サーミ出身の謎めいた少女で、炎を操る強力なオリジニウムアーツを持つ。近衛オペレーターとして壊滅的な近接アーツ火力を持つ。

faq.question: Is Surtr the best DPS in Endfield?
faq.questionZh: 史尔特尔是Endfield最强输出吗？
faq.answer: Surtr is one of the top DPS operators in Endfield, especially excelling in arts damage and boss fights.
faq.answerZh: 史尔特尔是Endfield中最强的输出之一，尤其在源石技艺伤害和Boss战中表现出色。

tierReason: Top-tier Arts DPS with massive burst damage potential. Dominates boss fights.
tierReasonZh: 顶级源石技艺主C，拥有极高的爆发伤害潜力，Boss战统治者。

normalAttack.name: 焚火剑术
normalAttack.description: 使用蕴含源石技艺的巨剑进行至多四段的连续攻击，造成源石技艺伤害。
normalAttack.descriptionEn: Performs up to 4 consecutive attacks with an Arts-infused greatsword, dealing Arts damage.
normalAttack.descriptionJa: アーツを纏った大剣で最大4段の連続攻撃を行い、アーツダメージを与える。

skill.name: 熔毁
skill.description: 引爆源石技艺，对前方扇形区域造成大量源石技艺伤害，并使目标防御力降低。
skill.descriptionEn: Detonates Originium Arts, dealing massive Arts damage in a frontal cone and reducing target DEF.

ultimate.name: 诸神黄昏
ultimate.description: 进入黄昏状态，大幅提升攻击力和源石技艺伤害，普攻转化为范围源石技艺攻击，持续15秒。
ultimate.descriptionEn: Enters Twilight state, greatly boosting ATK and Arts damage. Normal attacks convert to AoE Arts attacks for 15s.

passive.name: 不息炽焰
passive.description: 攻击命中时，有25%概率附加灼烧效果，每秒造成攻击力30%的源石技艺伤害，持续5秒。
passive.descriptionEn: On hit, 25% chance to apply Burn, dealing 30% ATK as Arts damage per second for 5s.
passive.descriptionJa: 攻撃命中時、25%の確率で燃焼効果を付与し、毎秒攻撃力30%のアーツダメージを5秒間与える。

teamComps.name: 源石技艺爆发队
teamComps.description: 以史尔特尔为核心输出，安洁莉娜提供攻速增益，阿米娅副C，塞雷娅治疗。
teamComps.descriptionEn: Centered on Surtr as main DPS, with Angelina for ATK speed buffs, Amiya as sub-DPS, and Saria healing.

name: 阿米娅
description: 罗德岛的领袖，年轻的卡特斯少女。拥有强大的源石技艺天赋，是团队中不可或缺的核心力量。
descriptionEn: Leader of Rhodes Island, a young Cautus girl with powerful Originium Arts talent. An indispensable core force in any team.
descriptionJa: ローズアイランドのリーダーである若いカータスの少女。強力なオリジニウムアーツの才能を持ち、チームに不可欠な戦力。

faq.question: Is Amiya a good character in Endfield?
faq.answer: Amiya is the story protagonist and a solid Arts caster with good sustained damage. Free to all players.
faq.answerZh: 阿米娅是故事主角，拥有优秀的持续源石技艺输出能力，所有玩家免费获取。

tierReason: Solid free Arts DPS with good sustained damage. Great for story progression.
tierReasonZh: 优秀的免费源石技艺输出，持续伤害稳定，剧情推进好帮手。

normalAttack.name: 源石射线
normalAttack.description: 发射源石技艺能量射线，对目标造成源石技艺伤害。
normalAttack.descriptionEn: Fires Originium Arts energy rays at the target, dealing Arts damage.
normalAttack.descriptionJa: オリジニウムアーツのエネルギー光線を放ち、目標にアーツダメージを与える。

skill.name: 精神爆发
skill.description: 集中精神力，对目标区域释放源石技艺爆发，造成范围源石技艺伤害。
skill.descriptionEn: Concentrates mental energy to unleash an Arts burst on the target area, dealing AoE Arts damage.

ultimate.name: 奇美拉
ultimate.description: 解放源石技艺的真正力量，大幅提升自身攻击力和源石技艺伤害，并改变攻击方式为范围源石技艺攻击。
ultimate.descriptionEn: Unleashes the true power of Originium Arts, greatly boosting own ATK and Arts damage, converting attacks to AoE Arts.

passive.name: 源石共鸣
passive.description: 每次攻击提升自身源石技艺伤害2%，最多叠加5层。
passive.descriptionEn: Each attack increases own Arts damage by 2%, stacking up to 5 times.
passive.descriptionJa: 攻撃するたびに自身のアーツダメージが2%上昇、最大5層まで重複。

teamComps.name: 源石技艺爆发队
teamComps.description: 以史尔特尔为主C，安洁莉娜辅助，阿米娅担任副C提供额外输出。
teamComps.descriptionEn: With Surtr as main DPS, Angelina supporting, and Amiya as sub-DPS providing extra damage.

name: 塞雷娅
description: 莱茵生命的前防卫科主任，现为罗德岛的重装干员。拥有强大的防御和治疗能力，是队伍中不可或缺的守护者。
descriptionEn: Former head of the Defense Division at Rhine Lab, now a Defender operator at Rhodes Island. Possesses powerful defensive and healing abilities, an indispensable guardian.
descriptionJa: ライン生命の元防衛部門主任、現在はローズアイランドの重装オペレーター。強力な防御と治癒能力を持ち、チームに不可欠な守護者。

faq.question: Is Saria good in Endfield?
faq.answer: Saria is the best tank-healer hybrid in Endfield. Her ability to heal while tanking makes her a top pick.
faq.answerZh: 塞雷娅是Endfield中最强的坦克治疗混合型干员，兼具治疗和承伤能力，首选推荐。

tierReason: Best tank-healer hybrid. Provides healing, shielding, and taunt — fits any team.
tierReasonZh: 最强坦克治疗混合体，提供治疗、护盾和嘲讽，适配任何队伍。

normalAttack.name: 防御打击
normalAttack.description: 使用盾牌进行近战攻击，造成物理伤害并恢复少量生命值。
normalAttack.descriptionEn: Performs melee attacks with shield, dealing Physical damage and recovering a small amount of HP.
normalAttack.descriptionJa: 盾で近接攻撃を行い、物理ダメージを与え、少量のHPを回復する。

skill.name: 钙质化
skill.nameJa: カルシフィケーション
skill.description: 释放源石技艺，为周围友方单位恢复生命值并提升防御力。
skill.descriptionEn: Releases Originium Arts, restoring HP and boosting DEF for nearby allies.

ultimate.name: 急救力场
ultimate.description: 展开大范围治疗力场，持续为全体友方恢复生命值，并使范围内敌人受到的源石技艺伤害提升。
ultimate.descriptionEn: Deploys a wide healing field, continuously restoring HP for all allies and increasing Arts damage taken by enemies within range.

passive.name: 医疗护卫
passive.description: 每当受到攻击时，恢复自身最大生命值3%的生命值，每2秒触发一次。
passive.descriptionEn: When attacked, recovers 3% of max HP. Can trigger once every 2s.
passive.descriptionJa: 攻撃を受けた時、最大HPの3%を回復。2秒に1回まで発動。

teamComps.name: 源石技艺爆发队
teamComps.description: 以史尔特尔为主C，安洁莉娜辅助，阿米娅副C，塞雷娅担任坦克和治疗。
teamComps.descriptionEn: With Surtr as main DPS, Angelina supporting, Amiya as sub-DPS, and Saria as tank and healer.

name: 银灰
description: 喀兰贸易公司的CEO，谢拉格的实际统治者。拥有出色的商业头脑和强大的战斗力，近战物理输出的巅峰。
descriptionEn: CEO of Karlan Trade Co. and de facto ruler of Kjerag. Possesses exceptional business acumen and combat prowess. Peak melee Physical DPS.
descriptionJa: カールラン貿易会社のCEO、シェラグの事実上の支配者。卓越したビジネスセンスと強力な戦闘力を持つ、近接物理火力の頂点。

faq.question: Is SilverAsh still good in Endfield?
faq.answer: SilverAsh remains one of the top Physical DPS in Endfield with his powerful true damage ultimate.
faq.answerZh: 银灰凭借强力的真实伤害终极技，仍然是Endfield中顶级物理输出之一。

tierReason: Top Physical DPS with true damage ultimate. Great for high-DEF enemies.
tierReasonZh: 顶级物理输出，拥有真实伤害终极技，对付高防敌人效果极佳。

normalAttack.name: 雪境剑术
normalAttack.description: 使用家族传承的剑术进行至多五段的连续攻击，造成物理伤害。
normalAttack.descriptionEn: Performs up to 5 consecutive attacks using family sword techniques, dealing Physical damage.
normalAttack.descriptionJa: 家伝の剣術で最大5段の連続攻撃を行い、物理ダメージを与える。

skill.name: 鹰眼
skill.description: 提升自身攻击范围和暴击率，同时获得远程攻击能力。
skill.descriptionEn: Increases own attack range and CRIT rate while gaining ranged attack capability.

ultimate.name: 真银斩
ultimate.description: 释放全力一击，对前方大范围敌人造成真实伤害，无视防御力。
ultimate.descriptionEn: Unleashes a full-power slash, dealing True damage to enemies in a wide frontal area, ignoring DEF.

passive.name: 领袖气质
passive.description: 在场时，所有友方单位的部署费用恢复速度提升15%。
passive.descriptionEn: While on the field, all allies' DP recovery speed increases by 15%.
passive.descriptionJa: フィールドにいる間、全味方のDP回復速度が15%上昇。

teamComps.name: 物理爆发队
teamComps.description: 以银灰为物理主C，安洁莉娜提供攻速增益，塞雷娅治疗，阿米娅提供源石技艺支援。
teamComps.descriptionEn: With SilverAsh as Physical main DPS, Angelina for ATK speed buffs, Saria healing, and Amiya for Arts support.

name: 能天使
description: 来自拉特兰的萨科塔天使，开朗活泼的狙击干员。拥有极高的物理攻击速度和暴击率，是远程物理输出的佼佼者。
descriptionEn: A Sankta angel from Laterano, a cheerful and lively Sniper operator. Possesses extremely high Physical ATK speed and CRIT rate, an outstanding ranged Physical DPS.
descriptionJa: ラテラーノ出身のサンクタ天使、明るく活発なスナイパーオペレーター。非常に高い物理攻撃速度と会心率を持ち、優秀な遠距離物理火力。

faq.question: Is Exusiai good in Endfield?
faq.answer: Exusiai is a top-tier ranged Physical DPS with incredible attack speed and burst potential.
faq.answerZh: 能天使是顶级远程物理输出，拥有极高的攻击速度和爆发潜力。

tierReason: Top ranged Physical DPS with extreme ATK speed. Excellent for clearing waves.
tierReasonZh: 顶级远程物理输出，攻击速度极高，清杂能力出色。

normalAttack.name: 天使射击
normalAttack.description: 使用弩箭进行快速射击，造成物理伤害。攻击速度极快。
normalAttack.descriptionEn: Fires rapid crossbow bolts, dealing Physical damage. Extremely high ATK speed.
normalAttack.descriptionJa: クロスボウで高速射撃を行い、物理ダメージを与える。攻撃速度が非常に速い。

skill.name: 冲锋模式
skill.description: 切换为冲锋射击模式，大幅提升攻击速度但降低单次伤害。
skill.descriptionEn: Switches to assault fire mode, greatly increasing ATK speed while reducing per-shot damage.

ultimate.name: 扫射模式
ultimate.nameJa: ストラフィングモード
ultimate.description: 进入全力扫射状态，对前方锥形区域内的所有敌人进行疯狂射击，造成大量物理伤害。
ultimate.descriptionEn: Enters full strafing state, unleashing a barrage of shots at all enemies in a frontal cone, dealing massive Physical damage.

passive.name: 精准天赋
passive.description: 暴击率提升15%，暴击时额外造成攻击力20%的伤害。
passive.descriptionEn: CRIT rate increased by 15%. On CRIT, deals an additional 20% ATK as bonus damage.
passive.descriptionJa: 会心率が15%上昇。会心時に攻撃力20%分の追加ダメージを与える。

teamComps.name: 物理射击队
teamComps.description: 以能天使为远程主C，银灰提供近战支援，安洁莉娜增益，塞雷娅治疗。
teamComps.descriptionEn: With Exusiai as ranged main DPS, SilverAsh for melee support, Angelina for buffs, and Saria healing.

name: 德克萨斯
description: 企鹅物流的成员，来自拉特兰的沉默寡言的鲁珀少女。作为先锋干员，她能在战斗初期快速获取部署费用并提供可靠的输出。
descriptionEn: A member of Penguin Logistics, a taciturn Lupo girl from Laterano. As a Vanguard operator, she quickly generates DP in the early battle phase while providing reliable damage.
descriptionJa: ペンギン急便のメンバー、ラテラーノ出身の無口なルポの少女。先鋒オペレーターとして、戦闘序盤で素早くDPを獲得しつつ安定した火力を出す。

faq.question: Is Texas a good Vanguard in Endfield?
faq.questionZh: 德克萨斯是好的先锋吗？
faq.answer: Texas is a reliable Vanguard with good DP generation and crowd control. Great for starting any team.
faq.answerZh: 德克萨斯是可靠的先锋，拥有优秀的DP获取和控场能力，适合任何队伍开局。

tierReason: Solid Vanguard with good DP generation and stun CC. Reliable pick for any team.
tierReasonZh: 稳健的先锋，DP获取优秀且有眩晕控场，任何队伍都能用的可靠选择。

normalAttack.name: 剑刃突击
normalAttack.description: 使用双剑进行快速近战攻击，造成物理伤害。
normalAttack.descriptionEn: Performs rapid melee attacks with twin swords, dealing Physical damage.
normalAttack.descriptionJa: 双剣で高速近接攻撃を行い、物理ダメージを与える。

skill.name: 冲锋号令
skill.description: 立即获得部署费用，并对周围敌人造成物理伤害和眩晕效果。
skill.descriptionEn: Immediately gains DP and deals Physical damage with Stun to surrounding enemies.

ultimate.name: 剑雨
ultimate.description: 召唤大量剑雨降落，对大范围敌人造成物理伤害并附加眩晕，同时获得大量部署费用。
ultimate.descriptionEn: Summons a rain of swords, dealing Physical damage and Stun to enemies in a wide area while gaining a large amount of DP.

passive.name: 先锋本能
passive.description: 部署后立即获得10点部署费用，并在场上时每秒额外获得1点部署费用。
passive.descriptionEn: On deployment, immediately gains 10 DP, and while on the field, gains 1 additional DP per second.
passive.descriptionJa: 配置時即座にDPを10獲得し、フィールドにいる間毎秒追加でDPを1獲得。

teamComps.name: 快速展开队
teamComps.description: 德克萨斯快速获取DP展开阵容，史尔特尔主C，安洁莉娜辅助，塞雷娅治疗。
teamComps.descriptionEn: Texas rapidly generates DP for team setup, Surtr as main DPS, Angelina supporting, Saria healing.

name: 芬
description: 罗德岛先锋干员，性格认真负责。擅长快速展开和部署费用获取，是新手期的重要战力。
descriptionEn: A Rhodes Island Vanguard operator, earnest and responsible. Excels at rapid deployment and DP generation, an important asset for new players.
descriptionJa: ローズアイランドの先鋒オペレーター、真面目で責任感が強い。迅速な展開とDP獲得に優れ、序盤の重要戦力。

faq.question: Should I build Fang in Endfield?
faq.answer: Fang is a solid early-game Vanguard for DP generation. Useful until you get higher-rarity Vanguards.
faq.answerZh: 芬是前期获取部署费用的可靠先锋，在获得高星先锋之前都很实用。

tierReason: Reliable low-rarity Vanguard for DP generation. Good for early game.
tierReasonZh: 可靠的低星先锋，适合前期DP获取，开荒好帮手。

normalAttack.name: 突击枪术
normalAttack.description: 使用长枪进行近战攻击，造成物理伤害。
normalAttack.descriptionEn: Performs melee attacks with a spear, dealing Physical damage.
normalAttack.descriptionJa: 槍で近接攻撃を行い、物理ダメージを与える。

skill.name: 冲锋号令·突破
skill.description: 立即获得部署费用，并短暂提升自身攻击速度。
skill.descriptionEn: Immediately gains DP and briefly boosts own ATK speed.

ultimate.name: 全力突刺
ultimate.description: 全力向前突刺，对路径上的敌人造成物理伤害，并获得部署费用。
ultimate.descriptionEn: Performs a full-power thrust, dealing Physical damage to enemies in the path and gaining DP.

passive.name: 先锋训练
passive.description: 部署后立即获得8点部署费用。

name: 清道夫
description: 罗德岛先锋干员，沉默寡言的行动派。在战场上以高效的战斗风格获取部署费用。
descriptionEn: A Rhodes Island Vanguard operator, a woman of few words and decisive action. Generates DP efficiently on the battlefield.
descriptionJa: ローズアイランドの先鋒オペレーター、無口な行動派。戦場で効率的な戦闘スタイルでDPを獲得する。

faq.question: Is Scavenger worth building?
faq.answer: Scavenger is a decent 4-star Vanguard. Build her if you need DP generation and don't have better options.
faq.answerZh: 清道夫是不错的四星先锋，如果缺少更好的先锋可以培养。

tierReason: Decent 4-star Vanguard with reliable DP generation.
tierReasonZh: 不错的四星先锋，DP获取稳定。

normalAttack.name: 斩击
normalAttack.description: 使用武器进行近战斩击，造成物理伤害。
normalAttack.descriptionEn: Performs melee slashes, dealing Physical damage.
normalAttack.descriptionJa: 武器で近接斬撃を行い、物理ダメージを与える。

skill.name: 快速冲锋
skill.description: 立即获得部署费用，并提升自身攻击力。
skill.descriptionEn: Immediately gains DP and boosts own ATK.

ultimate.name: 清扫模式
ultimate.description: 进入清扫模式，对周围敌人造成范围物理伤害，并获得部署费用。
ultimate.descriptionEn: Enters sweep mode, dealing AoE Physical damage to nearby enemies and gaining DP.

passive.name: 战场清扫
passive.description: 击倒敌人时获得额外2点部署费用。
passive.descriptionEn: Gain 2 additional DP when defeating an enemy.
passive.descriptionJa: 敵を倒した時、追加でDPを2獲得。

name: 梓兰
description: 罗德岛术师干员，拥有稳定的源石技艺输出能力。虽然星级不高，但作为源石技艺输出手值得培养。
descriptionEn: A Rhodes Island Caster operator with stable Arts damage output. Despite lower rarity, she's worth building as an Arts DPS.
descriptionJa: ローズアイランドの術師オペレーター。安定したアーツ火力を持つ。レアリティは低いがアーツ火力要員として育成の価値あり。

faq.question: Should I build Orchid in Endfield?
faq.answer: Orchid is a decent budget Arts caster. Useful early game until you get 5-6 star alternatives.
faq.answerZh: 梓兰是不错的低配源石技艺术师，在获得五星六星替代之前的前期很实用。

tierReason: Solid budget Arts Caster for early game progression.
tierReasonZh: 稳健的低配源石技艺术师，适合前期推进。

normalAttack.name: 源石弹
normalAttack.description: 发射源石技艺能量弹，造成源石技艺伤害。
normalAttack.descriptionEn: Fires Originium Arts energy bolts, dealing Arts damage.
normalAttack.descriptionJa: オリジニウムアーツのエネルギー弾を放ち、アーツダメージを与える。

skill.name: 源石聚能
skill.description: 集中源石技艺能量，短暂提升自身源石技艺伤害。
skill.descriptionEn: Concentrates Originium Arts energy, briefly boosting own Arts damage.

ultimate.name: 源石风暴
ultimate.description: 释放源石技艺风暴，对大范围敌人造成持续源石技艺伤害。
ultimate.descriptionEn: Unleashes an Arts storm, dealing continuous Arts damage to enemies in a wide area.

passive.name: 源石感知
passive.description: 攻击源石技艺抗性较低的敌人时，伤害提升15%。
passive.descriptionEn: Deals 15% more damage to enemies with lower Arts RES.
passive.descriptionJa: アーツ耐性が低い敵へのダメージが15%上昇。
